# Aussie Growth

> Aussie Growth is an Australian digital marketing studio. It builds websites, runs paid ads (Google, Meta, Instagram) and sets up AI and automation (CRM, instant replies, follow-up, booking) for tradies, home-service businesses and local businesses.

Official website: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/
Phone: +61 493 721 273
Email: meharmalik2026@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/): what Aussie Growth does, featured work, FAQs and the quote form
- [Web Development](https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/web-development/): business websites, redesigns, landing pages, quote and booking systems, and the build process
- [Growth](https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/growth/): paid ads management and AI/automation services

## Notes

- Portfolio projects shown on the site are real websites built by Aussie Growth.
- Photography and the brand film on the site are illustrative, not client footage.
- The site publishes no client testimonials, ratings or performance statistics.
